definitions.faithfulness: answers where the judge says every fact is supported / answered questions the judge could grade
definitions.answer_relevance: answers the judge says address the question / answered questions the judge could grade
definitions.hallucination_rate: sentences the judge says are NOT supported / all sentences checked (answered questions only)
definitions.citation_correctness: answers whose cited chunks contain the gold evidence passage / answered questions
definitions.citation_present_rate: answers with at least one [n] citation / answered questions
